items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Charlie Armstead. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead.

ctx.x: Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead. Charlie Armstead. And you know you had Bill Doggett would come down there. And they had the New Pelican uptown, where Count Basie came, the Gypsy Garden, the Gypsy Tea Room, all those kind of places went off, what I'm talking about in the early 50s.
So you remember Professor Longhair's band?
